purpose: Record the bounded TaskManager event/computed repair probe before a fresh pipeline regression
observed_diff: The task-list empty on-dragover binding became prevent:noop, with a root no-op method.
A pure isOverdueHelper was added and substituted for this.isOverdue calls in computed and related count methods.
Existing modal on-click bindings and close-button handlers were not changed.
caveats: The original isOverdue component method retains a duplicate copy of the calculation rather than delegating to the helper; both bodies currently match.
The event gate does not prove runtime equivalence of the pre-existing modal @click.self behavior.
This result is a local probe from a previously generated round-2 candidate, not a fresh Vue-to-San batch or independent holdout result.
Browser manual review was not performed.
next_step: Run a fresh, single-sample TaskManager development regression from frozen Vue under the updated two-error repair prompt, then freeze and inspect it before manual review.
